items.title: Night Core – A WASM execution firewall for AI agents and untrusted code
items.raw_excerpt: I’ve been exploring the risks of letting autonomous AI agents generate or execute code — especially via WASM. Night Core is a lightweight console that treats execution as a boundary, not just output. It uses signature-based validation, human approval queues, and sandboxed runtimes (like Wasmtime) to let you review or reject what runs — before it happens. Demo screenshots: https://x.com/xnfinitecore/status/2010067157774991457?s=46 Still early, but open to ideas, pushback, and contributions. Curious if others are thinking about this edge.

items.title: What happens to an economy when AI makes most human labor optional
items.raw_excerpt: I keep seeing two extreme futures discussed around AI. One is techno utopia: AI does everything, productivity explodes, humans are free to create and chill. The other is collapse: AI replaces jobs, wealth concentrates, consumption dies, society implodes. What I don’t see discussed enough is the mechanism between those states. If AI systems genuinely outperform humans at most economically valuable tasks, wages are no longer the primary distribution mechanism. But capitalism today assumes wages are how demand exists. No wages means no buyers. No buyers means even the owners of AI have no customers. That feels less like a social problem and more like a systems contradiction. Historically, automation shifted labor rather than deleting it. But AI is different in that it targets cognition itself

excerpt_i18n.zh: 一位开发者创建了AI领域顶级X账号互动关系的可视化分析工具，通过该工具可以直观展示AI领域关键意见领袖之间的互动网络。该可视化项目已在Hacker News平台分享，旨在帮助用户更好地理解AI社区内的交流模式与影响力结构。

items.title: When AI Speaks, Evidence Becomes the Control Surface
items.raw_excerpt: As AI systems communicate directly with customers and patients, organisations face a new governance risk: proving what was said. Why evidence, not performance, is becoming the control surface.

title_i18n.en: When AI Speaks, Evidence Becomes the Control Surface
title_i18n.zh: 当人工智能发言时，证据成为控制界面。
title_i18n.es: Cuando la IA habla, la evidencia se convierte en la superficie de control.

excerpt_i18n.en: As AI systems communicate directly with customers and patients, organisations face a new governance risk: proving what was said. Why evidence, not performance, is becoming the control surface.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 随着人工智能系统直接与客户和患者沟通，组织面临新的治理风险：如何证明对话内容。为何证据而非表现正成为控制的关键。
excerpt_i18n.es: A medida que los sistemas de IA se comunican directamente con clientes y pacientes, las organizaciones enfrentan un nuevo riesgo de gobernanza: demostrar lo que se dijo. Por qué la evidencia, no el rendimiento, se está convirtiendo en la superficie de control.

items.title: AgentWallet – Open-source financial infrastructure for AI agent
items.raw_excerpt:
Hey HN, I built AgentWallet — an open-source SDK for giving AI agents financial capabilities with built-in guardrails. The core idea: as agents become more autonomous (browsing, purchasing, hiring services), they'll need a safe way to handle money. Not "here's my API key to Stripe" but actual wallets with spend controls, audit trails, and human oversight. Features:
- Agent wallets with balance tracking
- Configurable spend rules (daily limits, per-transaction caps, category whitelists, approval workflows)
- REST API designed for agent integration
- Dashboard UI for monitoring
- Stripe integration for real deposits/withdrawals Tech: Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, React This is early, but functional. I'd love feedback from anyone building agents or thinking about agent infrastructure. GitHub:
